==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Androl Genhald]]}}
[[Welyn Kajima]] sits in the inn's common room and tells the gathering that [[Logain Ablar]] and [[Mazrim Taim]] have patched their differences, citing a concern over the [[Last Battle]]. [[Androl Genhald]] stands by the door with [[Pevara Tazanovni]] and watches the unbelievable scene; he notes that Welyn's face and voice were not as he remembered. [[Jonneth Dowtry]] demands to know where Logain is, and why he can't speak for himself. Androl respects the honesty from the [[Two Rivers]] [[Asha'man]] but silently pleads for caution. He is dismayed that there is an [[Aes Sedai]] in his head and assumes the [[void]] in order to shield his thoughts. Pevara admits that it is now harder to read his thoughts. [[Lind Taglien]], the innkeeper, cuts off Jonneth's questioning, saying he's tired and to leave him to his drink. Lind then approaches Androl and says Welyn's change makes no sense and offers to have her husband follow him, but Androl says it's too dangerous. He asks her to just listen to any conversations Welyn has tonight instead and let him know about anything odd. He also recommends she and her husband take shelter in their cellar with supplies after closing. As Androl is leaving, he is confronted by [[Mezar Kurin]], who has been one of Taim's men since the beginning, who overheard Androl's comment about the innkeeper using the cellar tonight. Androl says he doesn't like how bad the storm is and it was merely a recommendation. [[Coteren]], who accompanied Kurin to the inn, then tells Androl he has been demoted back to Soldier and, after another failed attempt to open a gateway, Androl drops his Dedicated sword pin to the floor. As they leave, he tells his allies they will find out what's going on in the Black Tower that night. 

:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}
Rand thinks on how he has changed and what more he can do, such as learning Healing from [[Damer Flinn]]. He wants to feel more like the son of [[Tam al'Thor]] than the Dragon Reborn but knows that's no longer possible. He goes back to researching maps of the area when [[Aviendha]] arrives and tells him he is to bed her. They exchange flirtatious banter, and as the [[Maidens of the Spear|Maidens]] cheer on Aviendha and insult Rand, they slip into his tent.

:{{pov|[[Pevara Tazanovni]]}}
Pevara tells Androl she suspects Taim has a ''[[Ter'angreal]]'' that is [[dreamspike|preventing gateways]]. Androl then explains why he is called pageboy by Taim's lackeys, saying he's always been able to form gateways, as large as 30 feet across, even with his small power in ''[[saidin]]''. Pevara suggests the [[The White Tower|White Tower]] would like to study this [[Talent]] as usually a gateway requires great strength in the power but Androl says he has no desire to go there. As they talk, she realizes she can sense a little of what he is thinking, but that he is much better at sensing what she is thinking. She thinks that she needs to be rid of this unnatural bond and Androl says he will not take responsibility for the situation they're in since she bonded him first without asking. [[Dobser]] arrives, lured by [[Evin Vinchova|Evin]] and is shielded by Pevara. [[Leems]] and [[Welyn Kajima|Welyn]] come in, and try to shield Pevara, who is able to slice Leems' weave. In his shock from the recoil, she also shields him. Welyn runs, but she trips him and Androl knocks him out with a cudgel.
